description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Garnet (Summoning, Bard)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Garnet (Summoning, Bard)
description.text: Increases [Lightning Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Summoning or Bard abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Garnet (Lightning) after using two Summoning or Bard abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Divine Guardian+
description.text: Five single attacks (5.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, minimum damage 2000, restores 1000 HP to all allies

description.name: Spirit Attack: Garnet (Lightning)
description.text: Four single attacks (1.50 each), causes [Imperil Lightning (5s)]

description.name: Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
